description: Use this when the user wants a wider search of published literature on kratom, 7-OH, vapes, nicotine analogs, synthetic cannabinoids or cathinones, nitazenes, fentanyl analogs, hemp-derived cannabinoids, new psychoactive substances, or tianeptine, including studies outside the reviewed library. Searches The Wiley Rule's worldwide literature index, drawn from Europe PMC (all of PubMed) with author countries from OpenAlex. Indexed, not reviewed: metadata and links only, and inclusion does not mean The Wiley Rule has read or endorsed a study. Reviewed summaries are in search_research.

country.description: Optional two-letter author-country code, e.g. US, GB, TH

query.description: Keywords in title, authors or journal, e.g. 'metals disposable' or 'nitazene potency'

name: search_world_literature
title: Search all published studies worldwide (index)
